arena_ready: Confirm your own readiness. Both ready starts play early; preparation deadline also starts play automatically. Returns current state. If waiting, keep calling arena_wait through timeouts until play starts. Check phase/turn/preparation/clock after each response. Repeated calls do not restart clocks.
arena_join: Join with the user’s role invitation. Returns token, role, current state and full board/play-policy/preparation/clock rules. Save token; follow the rules, prepare, then arena_ready. Keep following until the game ends. Repeat the invitation to reconnect with the original name/model; model is optional and must be accurate.
arena_state: Read the complete current board, legal cells, lastMove, phase/turn/version, readiness, preparation and clock. No avatars or history by default. Optional afterSeq requests a bounded event page; continue with nextAfterSeq while hasMore. Board and eventSeq always describe the latest position, even when paging older events. Other roles’ notes are private; own note text is available through arena_replay.
arena_rules: Without path arguments, read full rules. With cell and direction, trace only that topology path: length counts distinct cells including the start (default target). Returns dimensions, directions, path, next and current progress/time. path.stop identifies a boundary or repeated cell; next is one step from the input. Geometry ignores occupancy; read arena_state for the board.
arena_move: Place a stone on your turn using cell (A1 bottom-left or numeric index), latest expectedVersion and unique requestId. Returns current board and time, without history. Success adds increment and switches clock. Retry with identical arguments and requestId; duplicate does not place again.
arena_note: Send one note to spectators at ply, anytime including preparation and off-turn. Only you and spectators can read it. Returns event metadata and current progress/time, without text echo, board or history. Sending does not stop clocks. Use a unique requestId; retry identically. Commentators require commentaryEnabled.
arena_wait: Wait up to 25 seconds for events after afterSeq; returns latest board/time plus a bounded event page, even on timeout. Continue with nextAfterSeq (not eventSeq when hasMore); default limit 20, maximum 50. Own notes are metadata only. Check current turn first and act promptly; returns immediately on your turn or game end. Keep waiting through timeouts during preparation, opponent turns or pauses; remain in this session until game ends or user stops you.
arena_replay: Read history on demand as a bounded event page (afterSeq default 0, limit default 20, max 50), plus current board/time. Move events contain coordinates; own notes include text, other roles’ notes remain private. Continue with nextAfterSeq while hasMore. No avatars or duplicate moves list. The board is current, not the position at the page’s last event.
arena_resign: Concede immediately after the game starts, even off-turn or while paused. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId; retry with identical arguments.
arena_draw: Offer, accept, decline or withdraw a draw. Accept/decline require the other player's current drawOffer.id as offerId; only its proposer may withdraw. A move clears the offer. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId; retry with identical arguments. The built-in AI responds according to arena_rules.
